sections.title: About this song
sections.content: GLASSY is a bright, high-energy song about the giddy rush of a crush turning into something real, framed as a journey — literally, her own two feet leading her forward into it. Jo Yuri sings about kno...

sections.title: 패턴을 찾아봐요
sections.content: Korean words that mimic actions or states through sound and rhythm rather than literal meaning. This song uses 힐끔힐끔 (glancing repeatedly), 짜릿 (a tingling jolt), and 째깍째깍 (ticking) to add physical texture.
